model: ecoLine NTU digital turbidity sensor (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: JUMO ecoLine NTU type 202670 with RS-485 Modbus RTU (interface description V1.01).
summary: The JUMO ecoLine NTU is an optical turbidity sensor with a built-in RS-485 Modbus RTU interface. Measurements are started by the master. This map covers the start command, the measurement status word, temperature and turbidity in NTU and FNU.

addressing.note: Tables list the Modbus PDU address in decimal and hex; the value goes into the request unchanged (the example reads the temperature at start address 0x0053).

source.title: JUMO ecoLine O-DO/NTU - Digital sensors for turbidity and oxygen measurement - Modbus interface description
source.pages: Data types and float example ch. 2.5-2.6 (pp. 10-13); serial settings ch. 5.1 (p. 21); O-DO tables pp. 25-27; NTU tables pp. 29-30

notes: Floats are IEEE 754 sent high word first (ABCD); the worked example returns 41 CA 66 66 = 25.3 °C for start address 0x0053.
Measurements are triggered: write a start command to register 1, wait at least 300 ms without any Modbus traffic, poll the status word at 82 until no field reads 7, then read the values.
Integers are unsigned 16-bit, high byte first.

Each 3-bit field: 0 OK, 1 OK but outside sensor spec, 2 OK with reduced accuracy, 3 OK (reserved), 4 failed outside spec, 5 failed (too much extraneous light), 6 failed (reserved), 7 not yet complete.
The status table names the third field FTU while the value table uses FNU; both refer to the formazin nephelometric reading.
The NTU step-by-step text mentions a start value of 31, but the address table lists only 1, 3 and 5; this map follows the table.
The document gives the address range 1-247 but does not state a factory default address.

registers.name: Measuring operation status
registers.description: Bits 0-2 temp, 3-5 NTU, 6-8 FNU; field value 7 = not done.

integration.summary: Write 3 (NTU) or 5 (FNU) to register 1, wait 300 ms, poll register 82 until no 3-bit field equals 7, then read 83-88 as ABCD floats.
integration.enable: Modbus RTU is the sensor's native interface; set the address with JUMO DSM software.
quirks: No Modbus requests are allowed for 300 ms after a start command.
setup: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; address 1-247.
Wire A/B on M12 pins 5/4; the sensor needs +5 V on pin 1.
gotchas: Strong ambient light makes readings fail (status 5) or lose accuracy (status 2).

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
